title: Greater or Less Song (Tiny Sparks original)

lines.text: Which is bigger, which is more?
Count them up, then you'll be sure!
Which is smaller, which is less?
Count and make your best guess!
Three red apples, five green pears,
count them up, the fruit's all there.
Five is more and three is less,
five is greater, yes, yes, yes!
Two little ducklings, four little frogs,
hopping and swimming by the logs.
Two is less and four is more,
four is greater, that's the score!
Which is bigger, which is more?
Count them up, then you'll be sure!
Which is smaller, which is less?
Count and make your best guess!
Gator's mouth is open wide,
hungry for the bigger side!
Snap, snap, snap, he eats the most,
he likes the bigger number most!
Six little stars and six little moons,
count them all, they're like balloons.
Not more, not less, they're just the same,
equal is the number name!
Which is bigger, which is more?
Count them up, then you'll be sure!
Which is smaller, which is less?
Count and make your best guess!
One little ant and ten little bees,
which is more? Count, if you please!
One is less and ten is more,
ten is greater, hear it roar!
Which is bigger, which is more?
Count them up, then you'll be sure!
Which is smaller, which is less?
Count and make your best guess!
Which is more, two or seven?
Seven!
Which is less, nine or four?
Four!
Which is more, eight or three?
Eight!
Five and five, more or less?
Same!
Make your arms a gator mouth,
open wide from north to south!
Chomp the bigger, chomp, chomp, chomp,
now jump up and stomp, stomp, stomp!
Let's think it slowly!
Which is more, three or one?
Three!
Which is less, five or two?
Two!
Which is bigger, which is more?
Count them up, then you'll be sure!
Which is smaller, which is less?
Count and make your best guess!
